title: Gated dry heating on r46 (declared before any evaluation)
made_after: r46 adopted. Hot dry regions remain too cold, mostly in summer (Najd Jul-Sep -6 to -7 C, Sahara Jun-Sep -3 to -4.5 C, Sahel -2.2 C annual, Deccan -2.5 C, Iran -2.2 C). Gated dry heating (e54 with coastal, warm-ground and annual-warmth gates) reached dev31 S 0.9909 on r40 but failed the then policy's no-group-worse rule (mid-latitude 1.0034, reports/TRANSPORT_WIND_20261031.md section 10); policy v3 judges overall accuracy (S49) instead.
search: Coordinate descent (scripts/joint_refit.py, pool_given_dev): objective = S_pool where S49 <= 0.9945 against r46, else 10 + S49; at most 40 evaluations.
selection: Lowest objective; must pass policy_v3 dev (S49<=0.995, T,P<=+1%) and fine28 against r46; then sealed set l once (calibration/sealed_20261116l).
caveat: Only fine28 and sealed set l are independent.
